stock-real-data-research.prompt: Read ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/stock-real-data-research.md for full instructions. Execute the complete pipeline: (1) connect to Fidelity via CDP port 9222 and extract cookies, (2) query all GraphQL endpoints for quotes, positions, sentiment, news, and events, (3) apply Munger 7 mental models and 5 consensus principles, (4) calculate MSFT total economic exposure, (5) check portfolio rules compliance, (6) generate bilingual HTML report following ${SRC_ROOT}/DESIGN.md, (7) save to Stock Analysis folder, open in Edge, and move to Reports tab group. Also create a session log MD file alongside the report.
stock-real-data-research.description: Generate stock strategy report using live Fidelity data, Munger models, and investment principles. Requires user presence (Fidelity session cookies).

constraints.notes: Fidelity session cookies expire after ~30min idle. User must be logged in on the VM before triggering.

receipt-ingest.prompt: Read ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/tax/receipt-ingest.md for full instructions. Execute the receipt ingest pipeline: (1) ingest new receipts from the requested source folder (default: OneDrive Screenshots) using `--no-scan`, (2) list pending scans, (3) read each pending image directly with the read tool and extract vendor/date/line items/totals/payment method/category guess — embed SKUs inside line item descriptions because the sku field is silently dropped, (4) save scan results via batch_update_from_scans, (5) apply company/category/project/reimbursable tags per the heuristics in the skill file, (6) promote drafts to the live store through project tooling (do NOT hand-edit receipts.json), and (7) produce a per-company summary plus duplicate audit. Always back up data\receipts.json before bulk changes. Never delegate OCR to sub-agents — direct Claude vision is materially more accurate.
receipt-ingest.inputPrompt: What to do? (e.g., 'ingest from OneDrive default', 'ingest from C:\path\to\folder for company island_meltdown', 'scan pending only', 'summary 2026-Q1 oakley', 'export oakley 2026-01-01:2026-03-31 for bookkeeping')
receipt-ingest.description: Ingest, scan with Claude vision, dedup, tag (company/category/project), and summarize business receipts for Oakley, Island Meltdown, Dexin, and personal expenses
